paragraphs.text: Hunding Gjornersen was the first leader of the Dominarian band of thieves known as Robaran Mercenaries , scouting the Jamuraan seas around the 3300s AR.

Since anyone could challenge him for leadership of the Robaran anytime, he was often forced to use his fists as a means of command. His ship was named Stangg 's Talon. Despite his terrifying sight, he was as charming a companion as one could wish for.
Sometime later, he quit for unknown reasons. His lieutenant, Adira Strongheart , took command, reforming the thieves' band into a motley mercenary army.

In contrast to the novel Johan , Hunding Gjornersen was still one of the Robaran Mercenaries in the Legend of Jedit Ojanen the comic He met Jedit Ojanen when they were captured by Sand Warriors and introduced him to his group.
In the novel, he is described as a dwarf. However, his creature type on the card became Human.
